prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Post-adoption and post-certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and activity displays showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt results.
Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt results, while mascot greetings and docking hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive major wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Visual Narrative Redesign: Redesigns the story intro screen to a story_scroll layout with animated visual cards highlighting key pet companion features. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s. A scannable visual scroll layout helps users digest companion value faster.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Split Layout Account Sync Sign-In Screen: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout featuring real-time account pet restoration status alongside login options. (why: Top support theme is lost or reset pets after signing in (8 emails), and 2 emails reported sign-in stalls. Clear visual sync context resolves sign-in friction.)
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Home Welcome Stage Layout: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a stage layout with clear visual indicators for pet controls and tray activation. (why: The final onboarding step conversion drops to 75.4%. Support emails highlight confusion about controlling, hiding, or seeing pets on desktop (6 emails).)
3: [adoption, layout] Certificate Stage Layout Customization: Swaps the adoption certificate screen layout to a stage view that highlights official pet adoption details and companion badge. (why: Improving emotional commitment on the adoption certificate increases completion through the remaining 68.9% adoption funnel drop.)
4: [home, notification] Background Generation Desktop Ready Notification: Enables automatic background desktop notification alerts when the pet finishes hatching while the user is in another app. (why: Home waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (38+ minutes), indicating users switch away while waiting and lose track of onboarding completion.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Pet Sync Security Badge: Displays a cloud account security badge component on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet progress is safely backed up. (why: 8 support complaints were about missing or reset pets after re-signing in. Reassuring account persistence directly at sign-in builds trust.)
6: [finish, hint] System Tray & Desktop Controls Tip Carousel: Adds a tip carousel component to the final home intro screen explaining how to locate, summon, and control the pet from the system tray. (why: 7 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or confusion on how to control and hide the pet post-onboarding.)
